# FDG8097

> DO use `XmlReader`, `IXPathNavigable`, or subtypes of `XNode` as input or output of members that accept or return XML.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.12 System.Xml Usage.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Test profile: test classes are public only for the test framework; their signatures are not API. Not machine-checkable as a positive rule: FDG8096 reports XmlNode and XmlDocument in public signatures. XPathDocument, which the body also names, is not reported there.

## From the book

Use these abstractions instead of `XmlDocument`, `XmlNode`, or `XPathDocument`, because this decouples the methods from specific implementations of an in-memory XML document and allows them to work with virtual XML data sources that expose `XNode`, `XmlReader`, or `XPathNavigator`.
